Dear [Miss Higginbotham](/person/693)
I think you will find the beginning of the stories in the [Castle builders](/book/18) & [Countess Kate](/book/44), which are in the hands of [Innes](/person/744), 31 Bedford Street Covent Garden.[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The question was evidently which were the earliest of the linked stories. Innes reprinted Countess Kate in 1892 and The Castle-Builders in 1896.
